title: [In silico Screening of Protein-Protein Interaction Modulators Using the p53 and 14-3-3y Proteins as an Example].
authors: Sargsyan, A A; Muradyan, N G; Arakelov, V G; Paronyan, A K; Arakelov, G G; Nazaryan, K B
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子动力学和虚拟筛选研究p53与14-3-3γ蛋白-蛋白互作调节剂，对象为蛋白-蛋白而非蛋白-DNA，方法虽含物理模拟但与本课题TF-DNA互作无关。
abstract: The study of the p53 protein and its interactions with other proteins is key to understanding the mechanisms by which p53 affects tumorigenesis. Mutations in the TP53 gene, which occur in approximately 50% of human cancers, often disrupt its function, highlighting its key role in tumorigenesis. Although structurally challenging due to the presence of unstructured regions, p53 has a well-documented role in DNA damage signaling and cancer progression. In this study, the interaction between p53 and 14-3-3gamma monomers was studied using in silico methods. Using tertiary structure modeling, molecular dynamics, molecular docking, and virtual ligand screening, we identified small molecule compounds that can modulate the interaction of p53 with 14-3-3gamma. Key findings of the study include identification of a ligand binding pocket in the p53-14-3-3gamma interaction interface, generation of full-length models of 14-3-3gamma and p53 using in silico methods, and selection of potential protein-protein modulators with high affinity for the proteins under study.
abstract_zh: 对p53蛋白及其与其他蛋白相互作用的研究，是理解p53影响肿瘤发生机制的关键。TP53基因突变约见于50%的人类癌症中，常破坏其功能，凸显了其在肿瘤发生中的核心作用。尽管由于存在无序区域而在结构上具有挑战性，p53在DNA损伤信号传导和癌症进展中的作用已有充分记录。本研究采用计算机模拟方法，研究了p53与14-3-3gamma单体之间的相互作用。通过三级结构建模、分子动力学 (molecular dynamics)、分子对接 (molecular docking) 和虚拟配体筛选，我们识别出能够调节p53与14-3-3gamma相互作用的小分子化合物。研究的主要发现包括：在p53-14-3-3gamma相互作用界面中识别出一个配体结合口袋，利用计算机模拟方法生成了14-3-3gamma和p53的全长模型，以及筛选出对所研究蛋白具有高亲和力的潜在蛋白-蛋白调节剂。
